note: Adapted from the original English description published with this species by Bacchus (1997); the alate, soldier and large worker are all described in prose, with measurement tables. The author groups the alate of this species with magnocellus, vadschaggae, alluaudanus and albopartitus. Several numbers in the OCR measurement table are misplaced (the row for head length including mandibles reads 118 —1-25 1212S), and are restored from context as 1.18—1.25 / 1.21.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head orange, brownish above the ocelli and at the fork of the cranial suture; frons and genae paler, head surface with many small yellow dots of unequal size scattered at the setal bases; anteclypeus yellowish white, postclypeus yellow, antennae pale yellow; pronotum yellow, distinctly paler than the head; legs pale yellow; abdominal tergites and sternites pale yellow; wings yellow, costal vein darker. Posterior part of head capsule arcuate, evenly rounded; setae numerous above the compound eyes, very few behind them, not extending beyond the eye bulge. Frontal gland pore a very small round pore, situated in front of the line joining the posterior margins of the compound eyes; central spot oval. Frons smooth. Only the trunk of the cranial suture visible. Compound eyes oval, ocelli short-oval; posterior margin of postclypeus almost semicircular, median suture distinct. Labrum width greater than length; antennae 15-segmented, segments 4 and 5 similar, segment 3 slightly smaller, segments 2 and 6 similar. Pronotum with numerous setae and a white median longitudinal stripe, anterior and posterior margins slightly concave. Posterior margins of meso- and metanota moderately incurved.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to orange-yellow; labrum yellow; mandibles brown with yellow bases; postmentum yellow, slightly darker than the genae; body, legs and antennae pale yellow. Head capsule short-rectangular; head length to mandible base 0.10—0.15 mm longer than maximum head width, setae from short to long, sides parallel or nearly parallel from near the posterior margin to near the antennal sockets; dorsal surface of head with numerous setae, the pair of setae on the frons very close together, only 0.05 mm apart. Labrum moderately long and broad, with 3 pairs of setae on the anterior third, the distinct posterior short setae less than half as long as the apical long pair, lateral margins convex, widest in the middle, converging anteriorly, apex pointed. Mandibles slender, apex weakly incurved. Antennae 12—13-segmented, segment 3 shortest, segment 4 slightly larger than segment 3, segment 1 larger than segment 2. Postmentum short and broad. Pronotum narrower than the head, lateral lobes with a few long setae, anterior margin with a small median notch, posterior margin slightly concave. Fore tibia weakly inflated.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: head capsule pale yellow to yellow, postclypeal pad deep yellow; body, legs and antennae yellowish white to pale yellow; mandibles brown with yellow bases. Head capsule subrectangular, sides converging posteriorly, posterior margin broadly and evenly rounded; head setae numerous, regularly and symmetrically arranged; cranial suture absent; postclypeus small, very flat bean-shaped, median suture moderately distinct; anteclypeus flat, projecting in the middle; labrum with a transverse sclerotic band, apex broadly rounded; postmentum with a few long setae; antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest, segments 4 and 5 similar, segments 1 and 2 subequal. Anterior lobe of pronotum small, anterior and posterior margins shallowly concave, corners rounded. Fore tibia not inflated; spurs 3, the dorsal spur almost as long as the outer ventral spur; fore coxa conical, the single seta on its front not spine-like.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate measurements (2 heads, 1 colony, mm): head length to anterior margin of postclypeus 1.08—1.16, head width including compound eyes 1.14—1.25, postclypeus length 0.28—0.30, width 0.55—0.59, labrum length 0.38, width 0.45—0.48, maximum diameter of compound eye 0.38—0.40, minimum diameter 0.33—0.35, maximum diameter of ocellus 0.18, minimum diameter 0.13, distance from ocellus to compound eye 0.03, pronotum length 0.75—0.88, width 1.05—1.15, hind tibia length 1.25—1.33. Soldier measurements (5 heads, 1 colony): head length including mandibles 1.18—1.25, head length to mandible base 0.75—0.81, head width behind antennal sockets 0.63—0.68, maximum head width 0.65—0.68, labrum length 0.25—0.30, width 0.20—0.21, left mandible transverse length 0.45—0.50, width 0.05, curvature 0.03, fore tibia length 0.45—0.48, width 0.10—0.11, hind tibia length 0.50—0.53, width 0.09—0.10, maximum pronotum width 0.43—0.45, postmentum length 0.38—0.40, maximum width 0.30—0.33. Large-worker measurements (3 heads, 1 colony): head length to anterior margin of postclypeus 0.88—0.89, maximum head width 0.78, postclypeal pad length 0.20, width 0.33—0.34, maximum pronotum width 0.40—0.43, fore tibia length 0.43, width 0.09—0.10, hind tibia length 0.45—0.48. The species was found in a small part of an Odontotermes nest.
